spear_dimensions.name: Speed
spear_dimensions.definition: How quickly the task is performed to standard under the given conditions.

spear_dimensions.name: Precision
spear_dimensions.definition: Accuracy and correctness of execution against the standard.

spear_dimensions.name: Executive Control
spear_dimensions.definition: Decision-making, sequencing, and self-regulation during execution.

spear_dimensions.name: Adaptability
spear_dimensions.definition: Adjustment to changing or degraded conditions while maintaining the standard.

spear_dimensions.name: Risk Exposure
spear_dimensions.definition: Degree to which the performance manages or increases risk to self, unit, and mission.
